Fruit Trees.description: High-yielding, premium grafted fruit plants suitable for home gardens and commercial orchards in Rajasthan and Northern India.

plants.name: Mango (Aam)
plants.watering: Regular watering when young, drought tolerant when mature
plants.careTips: Provide staking when sapling is young. Protect from winter frost in early years.

plants.name: Guava (Amrood)
plants.soil: Adaptable to various soils, prefers well-drained loam
plants.careTips: Prune lightly after fruiting to promote new shoots and higher yield.

plants.name: Pomegranate (Anaar)
plants.watering: Drought tolerant, moderate watering during flowering & fruit set
plants.careTips: Ideal for semi-arid Rajasthan climate. Ensure good drainage.

plants.name: Aonla / Amla (Indian Gooseberry)
plants.watering: Low to moderate, highly drought resilient
plants.soil: Light to medium soil, tolerates sodic & alkaline soils
plants.careTips: Extremely hardy plant with very high medicinal value and vitamin C.

plants.name: Sitafal (Custard Apple)
plants.soil: Rocky, sandy, or light well-draining soil
plants.careTips: Excellent low-maintenance fruit tree for dry climates.

plants.name: Chikoo (Sapodilla)
plants.careTips: Evergreen tree providing delicious year-round fruit.

plants.name: Lemon (Nimbu)
plants.watering: Regular watering; keep soil moist but never waterlogged
plants.soil: Well-draining, slightly acidic to neutral soil
plants.careTips: Feed with citrus fertilizer or organic compost every 2-3 months.

plants.name: Jamun (Black Plum)
plants.careTips: Fast-growing shade and fruit tree with proven diabetic health benefits.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Where is Shri Govindam Nursery located?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: We are located at Dhodhsar, Jaipur, Rajasthan 303712, India. Visitors are welcome anytime as we are open 24x7.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Do you provide plant home delivery in Jaipur?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, we provide home delivery for selected plants across Jaipur. For bulk or large tree transportation, please contact us on WhatsApp (+91 97725 85880) for arrangements.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How do I check exact plant prices and current stock?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Individual plant prices depend on sapling age, height, and bag size. Please message our nursery team on WhatsApp (+91 97725 85880) with your plant list for verified current prices and availability.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What is the Carbon Offset Certificate?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Our Carbon Offset program scientifically calculates the annual CO2 absorbed by the trees you plant. You can calculate your offset on our Carbon page and generate a branded certificate upon verified order confirmation.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Do you test soil before planting?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, our team can assess soil and water quality for farms and large orchards to recommend plant varieties best suited to your soil pH and salinity.

botRules.pricingPolicy: Never guess or invent prices for individual plants. Direct the customer to WhatsApp (+91 97725 85880) for real-time rates and bulk discounts.
